do.say: The air tastes of copper. Somewhere below, water drips, slowly, like a clock that has forgotten what it counts.

interact.look: An earth-box, split by frost or by a hand. Rats have nested in the spilt earth. It smells of the grave, and of something sweeter.
A coil of tarred rope, stiff but sound. The carters used it to lower boxes into the well-shaft.
interact.take_text: Sound rope, tarred and stiff. Whatever it was used to lower, it will serve to lower me.

interact.look: A brick-lined shaft, mouth rimmed with old mortar.

do.say: I drop a pebble. I count to nine before I hear it strike, and it does not splash. This was a well once. Now it is only a way for the cold to come up.
